## Acceptance criteria

> **READ `Deliverables/2026-08-18-what-a-capable-model-does-with-this-list.md` FIRST. It is the
> acceptance standard, not background** — Larry read the photograph and answered the same seven
> questions by reasoning. AsdAIr must reach those answers itself.

**AC1 — The model decides, with everything it needs in front of it.** An unresolved line goes to a
model call carrying: **Asdair's own contract** (`Team/Asdair - Household Shopping Steward/AGENTS.md`),
the **109-row household catalogue**, the **28 standing rules**, and the **Favourites list**. The
grounded read already sends 19,895 characters, so there is no cost or latency argument for withholding
any of it. **Send it all.**

**AC2 — Three outcomes, and the first two must actually happen.** For each unresolved line the model
returns exactly one of: **RESOLVED** (it names the product, with its reason) · **ASK** (a question a
person would recognise as intelligent, with only candidates it can justify — **an empty candidate list
is correct** when nothing plausible exists) · **CANNOT** (it says what it could not find). On the real
seven, RESOLVED must fire for rows 4, 5 and 7.

**AC3 — Favourites and rules are consulted BEFORE anyone is asked.** Rows 4 and 7 are in Warwick's
Favourites; row 5 has a standing rule and his own answer on 17 August was *"there is a rule about
this"*. **A rule that exists and is not consumed is FAIL** — the build's own words. This AC is the
whole of Warwick's complaint and it is not satisfied by better ranking.

**AC4 — An already-matched line is never asked about.** Rows 1 and 2 were matched at 0.99 and asked
anyway; row 2 quoted the product's own full catalogue name back at him. Establish why and close it.

**AC5 — The deterministic scorer stops deciding.** `regularCandidates()` is demoted to the fallback
used only when the model call is unavailable, and **that fallback must say it is degraded** rather than
present its guesses as judgement. **Do NOT fix it with a stopword list or a minimum score — that is
more of exactly what this order exists to stop.**

**AC6 — Proven on the REAL path, not in a unit test.** The acceptance evidence is the seven re-run
through the production route against the real catalogue, rules and Favourites. A green suite proves
capability only. **The canonical test in CLAUDE.md § "Nothing may live only in Larry's head" binds:
the real production event must exercise it.**
# guidance: each independently checkable. If automatic, no AC may be satisfiable by a manual invocation of the delivered script alone.
